C0952.title: Three Sentenced in Jiangxi for Forging and Trading Identity Cards
C0952.summary: Between March 2021 and July 2022, Zhou, Liu, and Yan engaged in construction qualification agency services. To profit, they purchased over 100 resident identity cards from multiple peers or commissioned counterfeit cards using others' personal information.
